description: Official complete JVM/Android runtime closure for the public AndroidX WebKit profile APIs. No bytecode trimming, custom boundary implementations, or model/runtime changes.

versionResolution.androidx.annotation:annotation: Select published JVM variant androidx.annotation:annotation-jvm:1.8.1; lower 1.0.0/1.1.0 requests satisfied by1.8.1
versionResolution.testDependencies: JUnit and Mockito are test scope, excluded from runtime closure
versionResolution.arch.core:core-runtime: Not in the resolved closure; its POM was inspected only

buildRequirements.aarMetadataPolicy: Preserve and check all published AAR metadata; compile SDK 35 and JDK 17 satisfy these artifacts. A standalone compatible D8 is required for Kotlin 2.1 metadata.

excludedJavaResources.META-INF/MANIFEST.MF: Conflicting source-JAR archive manifests are not Android runtime resources. APK signatures and manifest are generated by the application build.

d8.purpose: Build-time-only D8 compiler; not an application runtime dependency or APK input.
